flags: Mileage scopes differ: WYDOT identifies an official 47-mile designation with boundaries outside Shell and Dayton; tourism gives 58 miles, and material maps 51.4. Used the official designated length and distinguished the town approaches.

The principal WYDOT brochure dates to May 2000. Granite Creek remains a short historical account attributed to that brochure; current visibility of the tornado scar and condition of its sign are unverified.

Shell Falls hours and seasonal dates differ between the brochure and tourism page. Omitted operating hours and any present access guarantee. The driving practical is a general snow-closure statement checked only against the cache.

Dropped the current blanket Bighorn/Big Horn spelling rule: WYDOT calls it a rule of thumb, not an absolute rule. Kept the road’s established id and title usage while quoting publisher labels accurately.
The brochure extraction interleaves columns, so several evidence fragments jointly support complete sentences; no missing text was reconstructed inside quotes.
